coordinate_system.x: native STEP X; same as PCB editor X
coordinate_system.y: native STEP Y; opposite PCB editor Y; positive Y is the USB rear
coordinate_system.z: up from the case floor underside; both native board top faces remain +Z
coordinate_system.native_board_placement: Positive Z scale plus translation only; no reflection or 180-degree turnover.

carrier.geometry_source: Native routed KiCad board; exact re-imported finished-board bounds are recorded separately.

nucleo.geometry_source: Unmodified ST PcbDoc in the pinned archive; derived bare-board contour. Factory sockets and other parts are separate documented envelopes.

lcd.mounting: Two removable rear edge clamps, front edge lips and end stops; no assumed supplier hole pitch.

sensor.mounting: Two removable rear edge clamps, front edge lips and end stops.
sensor.transducer_geometry: Illustrative positions; the full rectangular aperture clears the published module face rather than assuming a can-center tolerance.

usb.measurement_required: The exact cable overmold and bend radius are not published in the selected product dimensions.

wire_harness.qualification: Route a service loop; full wire shape, bend radius and connector retention are not modeled.

required_measurements: Identify the purchased Nucleo board revision and measure factory Arduino socket height. The modeled 8.51 mm value is a declared assumption; a height above 8.86888 mm would consume the nominal insulator clearance.
Measure LCD PCB thickness, installed header orientation/height and glass projection; confirm both 0.6 mm edge-capture strips are free of glass, pads and components.
Measure HC-SR04 PCB thickness, rear components/header reach and clear edge strips before installing clamps.
Measure the actual USB cable overmold against the 18 ×10 mm opening and 16 ×8 mm checked plug envelope.
Check printed nut pockets, 0.3 mm module/tab clearances, screw engagement and local USB-bridge support removal.
Measure the completed wire routing, supply currents, ECHO levels and acoustic behavior with the closed case.
